name: Beibeilong
sum: Giant caenagnathid from the Late Cretaceous of Henan, China, named from an embryo found with huge Macroelongatoolithus eggs.
holotype: An embryonic skeleton (nicknamed "Baby Louie") with a partial clutch of eggs, Henan, China (Pu et al. 2017).
material: Only the holotype embryo and eggs.
biology: Laid some of the largest known dinosaur eggs, about 40–45 cm long with ornamented shells; adults are estimated among the largest oviraptorosaurs.
author: Pu et al. 2017
